description:
Found by s532c's s536 sweep (2026-11-08): #4301 made `defined *$v` honest (was always 1), and 22 rows of
perl-tests/magic.t "*^X appears to be defined at the outset" (^OPEN ^TAINT ... ^A ^C ... ^LAST_FH) went
158 -> 136 passing.  magic.t builds each caret name as
    if ($v =~ s/^\^(?=.)//) { for (substr $v, 0, 1) { $_ = chr(... - 64) } }
and PCL's `_foreach_alias_rewrite` (Pl/Parser.pm) recognised the magic-lvalue element only as Word +
argument-List, so the paren-less call lowered to plain `(p-substr $v 0 1)` -- a COPY: $v stayed "OPEN",
and `defined *{"OPEN"}` is honestly false.  The rows had passed on the always-true `defined`.

Reproducer (perl 5.40.3 prints xBC / Ay / A / 2 / AnC; ce665621 prints ABC / ABCD / NUL / 1 / ABC):
    my $w="ABC"; for (substr $w, 0, 1) { $_="x" } print "$w\n";
    my $v="ABCD"; for (substr $v, 1) { $_="y" } print "$v\n";
    my $b="\x00"; for (vec $b, 0, 8) { $_=65 } print "$b\n";
    my $p="aaa"; $p =~ /a/g; for (pos $p) { $_=2 } print pos($p), "\n";
    my $n="ABC"; $_="n" for substr $n, 1, 1; print "$n\n";

=== DONE (s532c) ===
FIXED in s532c (0affbe86): ONE predicate `Pl::Parser::_magic_lvalue_call_head` serves the head swap and
VarAnnotator's force-box of the scalar argument.  `substr` / `vec` are list operators: the element is the
call up to a low-precedence or / and / xor / not (perl dies on a fifth substr argument); the first argument
must be a Symbol / Magic token (`substr => 1` stays a string).  `pos` is a named unary: `pos $s` only
(`pos $x || pos $y` in perl-tests/or.t is NOT an lvalue and is declined).  magic.t one-file 158/31 with a
fail list identical to ce665621's; pos.t 19 -> 20 ("no assertion failure when getting pos clobbers ref
with undef" -- `for my $one (pos $x)` now aliases pos).  Guard Pl/t/lvalue-ref-01.t rows 19-20 (both FAIL
on ce665621).  ir-spec foreach section + docs/foreach-aliasing.md.
NOT covered (the paren form shares both, pre-existing): a magic-lvalue call INSIDE a multi-element list
(`for ($o, substr $m, 0, 1)` / `for ($o, substr($m, 0, 1))` copy -- #267's mixed-list residue), and a WRITE
through a substr cell whose first argument is an ELEMENT (#4309).
Status left for the reviewing session (agents never set completed).
